messages:
mira: Auditor Lucy requested a compact evidence bundle for INC-2026-0429. They specifically want: KMS key policy snapshots (before/after if changed), CloudTrail entries for Encrypt/Decrypt/GenerateDataKey, list-grants output, and any STS AssumeRole calls tied to KMS usage. Who can assemble?

devin: I can pull CloudTrail and KMS API outputs. Question: do we need kubernetes RBAC bindings correlated to the same window too? The incident touched a Pod that used a mounted IAM role.

auditor-lucy: Yes please. Provide k8s RoleBinding/Role change diffs, and kube-audit events for the window 2026-03-25T22:00:00Z to 2026-03-26T02:00:00Z. For KMS we also need the key rotation state and any external wrap key references. CSV or GraphML for the access graph is preferred.

mira: Plan: 1) export CloudTrail filter for EventName in [Encrypt, Decrypt, GenerateDataKey] and STS AssumeRole 2) export aws kms describe-key + list-grants + get-key-policy 3) dump IAM role -> principal mappings and run iam-graph tool for graphml 4) collect kube-audit logs and RoleBinding diffs 5) create tarball + sha256 + detached GPG sig, upload to evidence bucket with object-lock enabled.

evidence-bot: Playbook hint: include exporter identity, filename->sha256 manifest, time window, and control mapping (SOC2 CC6.2, ISO27001 A.9.2.1). See https://redwood.internal/docs/compliance/evidence-playbook

devin: Commands I'll run now:
```
aws cloudtrail lookup-events --lookup-attributes AttributeKey=EventName,AttributeValue=Encrypt --start-time "2026-03-25T22:00:00Z" --end-time "2026-03-26T02:00:00Z" > ct_encrypt.json
aws cloudtrail lookup-events --lookup-attributes AttributeKey=EventName,AttributeValue=Decrypt --start-time "2026-03-25T22:00:00Z" --end-time "2026-03-26T02:00:00Z" > ct_decrypt.json
aws cloudtrail lookup-events --lookup-attributes AttributeKey=EventName,AttributeValue=AssumeRole --start-time "2026-03-25T22:00:00Z" --end-time "2026-03-26T02:00:00Z" > ct_assumerole.json
aws kms describe-key --key-id arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:123:key/ef01ab23 > kms_describe.json
aws kms list-grants --key-id arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:123:key/ef01ab23 > kms_grants.json
aws kms get-key-policy --key-id arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:123:key/ef01ab23 --policy-name default > key_policy.json
kubectl get rolebinding,clusterrolebinding -A -o yaml > all_rolebindings.yaml
kubectl --namespace prod get rolebinding my-app-binding -o yaml > my-app-binding_before.yaml # if archived
python tools/iam_graph.py --input-roles iam_roles.csv --output inc2026_access.graphml
```

ops-oncall: When uploading, please call sts:GetCallerIdentity and include that result in manifest. Also set S3 Object Lock retention to 30d and tag evidence:INC-2026. Keep CloudTrail object keys referenced in manifest for traceability.

mira: We'll include a short vulnerability triage note: who triaged, CVSS if applicable, remediation status, and commit/PR references. Link to ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INC-2026-0429.

devin: Tarball steps:
```
tar czf inc2026_evidence_v1.tar.gz ct_encrypt.json ct_decrypt.json ct_assumerole.json kms_describe.json kms_grants.json key_policy.json all_rolebindings.yaml kube-audit.json inc2026_access.graphml triage_notes.md
sha256sum inc2026_evidence_v1.tar.gz > inc2026.sha256
gpg --output inc2026.sig --detach-sign --local-user compliance-signing-key inc2026_evidence_v1.tar.gz
```

auditor-lucy: Please ensure manifest.json has fields: files[], exported_by, exported_at, presigned_creator, presign_created_at, control_map, time_window, and any notes about object-lock. Attach the public key fingerprint for the GPG key used.

devin: Uploaded to s3://redwood-evidence/INC-2026-0429/ with object-lock enabled. Presigned URL created for auditor access (7d). I recorded CloudTrail PutObject event and the sts:GetCallerIdentity that preceded it.

mira: Added RoleBinding diff excerpt to manifest:
```
# rolebinding diff excerpt
- subjects: [{kind: ServiceAccount, name: build-bot}]
+ subjects: [{kind: ServiceAccount, name: build-prod}]
```

evidence-bot: Reminder: map artifacts to controls: map CloudTrail exports -> SOC2 CC6.2, key policy & list-grants -> ISO27001 A.9.2.1, object-lock & manifest -> evidence retent.

auditor-lucy: Received package and signature. I'll validate sha256 and GPG signature; then confirm whether we need raw S3 objects for deeper forensic validation. Early note: the rolebinding change needs a timeline narrative correlating Pod create events and KMS use.

devin: Noted. I'll draft a short timeline of events (timestamps + actor identities + signal sources) and attach to the evidence tarball as timeline.md.

mira: Thanks all. Once Lucy confirms validation I'll mark evidence:INC-2026-0429/v1 as delivered in the evidence tracker. If auditor requests replay data (raw CloudTrail S3 objects or API debug logs) we'll escalate to forensics channel.

ops-oncall: Good job. Also recommend we snapshot KMS key's key-material origin and rotation logs in case we need to prove non-rotation during window.

auditor-lucy: Confirmed: checksum and GPG sig validated. Opening a short follow-up for one missing kube-audit object; ping me if you need us to request extended retention. Thanks. :white_check_mark:
